read_only_evidence_verification.scope: Evidence identity only; no product behavior, human perception, reachability or audit closure is proven.

privacy_scan.scope: Recursive gzip and tar over archive; max depth 8 and per-view max 83,886,080 bytes.

result.qualification: Digest corpus is derived from restricted original GPU evidence, not hardcoded or printed. Text path/credential/email matches are candidates and require contextual classification; binary Git commit metadata remains separately disclosed. Per-view bytes and recursion depth are bounded; unsupported formats, excluded symlinks, unknown roots, encodings or credentials are not cleared. Git administrative metadata and history are omitted; the scan covers the specified working tree only. No product code is executed.

privacy_scan.limitations: Known restricted path-value and prefix digests plus selected path/credential patterns only; unknown values, encodings, formats, binary metadata and Git history are not generally cleared. No Git commit bodies or author metadata included.

qualification: Additive external receipt; evidence verification does not validate product behavior, reachability, policy or audit closure.
